battlefield-1942-anthology: Manual: retained 1.61 static engine. Review the legacy distribution and matching retail data before replacing it; no maintained version feed is configured.
assaultcube: Manual: reviewed engine and matching game data are pinned. A release needs a new checksum/dependency and client-protocol review before Queue update can install it.
terraria: Manual: the official Linux server archive is pinned to the reviewed release. Review a newer archive checksum and world/client compatibility before updating.
bzflag: Manual: reviewed Ubuntu binary is pinned to its package/dependency baseline. The agent does not run apt upgrade; review a new package baseline before updating.
hedgewars: Manual: reviewed Ubuntu server binary is pinned. Review package dependencies and matching client protocol before updating.
openttd: Manual: reviewed Ubuntu server binary is pinned. Review dependencies, client protocol and saved-game compatibility before updating.
luanti: Manual: reviewed Minetest/Luanti package and game data are pinned. Review dependency, game/mod and world compatibility before updating.
battle-for-wesnoth: Manual: reviewed server engine and runtime libraries are pinned together. Review the matching client branch and dependency baseline before updating.
rimworld-together: Manual: PlayBound-patched source build is pinned. Review upstream changes, reapply the integration and verify the compiled package before updating.
supertuxkart: Manual: reviewed dedicated binary and installed assets are pinned together. Review engine/assets and client compatibility before updating.
openarena: Manual: reviewed engine and installed game data are pinned together. Review new binaries, dependencies and matching protocol before updating.
xonotic: Manual: reviewed dedicated engine and game assets are pinned together. Review the complete publisher package before updating.
0ad: Manual: reviewed engine, scripts, assets and runtime dependencies are pinned together. Review the complete compatible package before updating.
teeworlds: Manual: reviewed Ubuntu server binary is pinned. Review dependencies and client protocol before updating; UID-isolated engines also require the root-owned reviewed manifest to match.
flightgear: Manual: reviewed multiplayer relay binary is pinned to its dependency baseline. Review and verify a new relay package before updating.
